_doc: WP-DEMO-01: what the J5 demo needs in the demo workspace, in promotion order. promote-plan.ts turns this into an offline dry-run plan (deploy.sh --print-plan, no network). Nothing here deploys.

globals.MERC_BUDDY_NUMBER: E.164 customer number routed to merc-buddy in the demo workspace (dev uses +18455133803)
globals.MERC_WHATSAPP_CONNECTION: WhatsApp connection name assigned to merc-buddy (template merc_buddy_ping approved)
globals.MERC_CHANNELS_LIVE: true only once the phone owner consents; false keeps every send recorded as not live
